channel.title: Nerdist Industries, LLC - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nerdist Industries, LLC (nerdist.com)

item.title: WONDER MAN Officially Coming Back for Season 2
item.description: In a welcome surprise, Marvel Television has renewed Wonder Man for a second season, with Yahya Abdul-Mateen and Ben Kingsley returning.

item.title: MISTER ROGERS' NEIGHBORHOOD Gets its Own YouTube Channel
item.description: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood is getting its own dedicated YouTube channel. The channel will include full episodes of the beloved show.

item.title: The Films We Can't Wait to See in 2026
item.description: From Avengers: Doomsday to Dune: Part Three, these are the films that we cannot wait to see on the big screen in 2026.

item.title: THE PUNISHER: ONE LAST KILL Will Premiere in May on Disney+
item.description: Frank Castle returns in The Punisher: One Last Kill, a Marvel Television Special Presentation coming to Disney+ on May 12.

item.title: FORBIDDEN FRUITS' Meredith Alloway on Giallo Films and Witchy Women
item.description: Forbidden Fruits director Meredith Alloway chats with us about her love for giallo films, crafting witchy characters, and much more.

item.title: Disney Pulls Out of OpenAI Deal Amid Sora Shut-Down
item.description: OpenAI has announced it's shutting down its Sora generative AI video app. As a result, Disney is backing out of its $1 billion investment.

item.title: DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN Season 2 Is Almost Too Real (Review)
item.description: Daredevil: Born Again season 2 takes much of its premise from the real world and it feels almost too real, especially for a superhero show.

item.title: Who Is Mr. Charles in DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN Season 2?
item.description: Daredevil: Born Again introduces us to Mr. Charles, a man with his own agenda (and a big sense of humor) in season two.

item.title: Wendy's New DC Rides Kids Meals Are Wonderfully Odd
item.description: These new Wendy's Kids' Meals include iconic DC Rides! Justice League heroes with their weird counterpart characters.

item.title: Stephen Colbert to Write Next THE LORD OF THE RINGS Movie
item.description: The Lord of the Rings superfan Stephen Colbert will co-write the franchise's next big movie based on the first six chapters in Fellowship.

item.title: JUMANJI Film Sequel Will Hit Theaters on Christmas Day
item.description: A Jumanji sequel is coming in December 2026 with Karen Gillan, Jack Black, Kevin Hart, and Dwayne Johnson reprising their roles.

item.title: Netflix Announces Cast for Live-Action SCOOBY DOO Series
item.description: The Scooby gang is getting a new look. Netflix announced on Wednesday the four actors set to star in the live-action Scooby Doo series.

item.title: This Hand-Crafted YU-GI-OH! Guitar Can Be Yours for $12,500
item.description: Artist Bear Walker collaborates with Konami to launch a very cool Yu-Gi-Oh! Red-Eyes Black Dragon Guitar. Check it out!

item.title: The New and Returning TV Shows We Can't Wait to See in 2026
item.description: From The Boys' final round to VisionQuest, these are the new and returning shows that we cannot wait to see in 2026.

item.title: Animals Try To Solve Hugh Jackman's Murder in THE SHEEP DETECTIVES Trailer
item.description: Hugh Jackman's animals try to solve his murder in the new trailer for the very silly, very real comedy-thriller The Sheep Detectives.
